source_observed_boundary.explanation_only: Architecture arrows, text-to-speech transformations, CFM/vocoder internal stages, moving dots, film timing. No attention/activation/CFM-step measurement or waveform quality proof.

not_verified: intelligibility or semantic accuracy against the input text
